lines.text: In seventeen minutes, an avalanche will wipe this ledge off the mountain.
Four hikers are stuck on it, with one lantern between them.
The only way off is an old rope bridge.
It holds two people at a time, and in this dark, nobody crosses without the lantern.
When two walk together, they move at the slower one's pace.
The obvious plan: Mia walks everyone across, and brings the lantern back each time.
But there is a way to get all four across in seventeen.
